pageBodyHtml:
Conference presentations

2025

  • RSNA 2025, Chicago — Cutting-Edge scientific presentation: Radiology's Last Exam (RadLE) 1.0.
  • RSNA 2025, Chicago — Collaborative presentation on integrated AI-PACS workflow and chest-imaging workload.
  • MICCAI 2025, Daejeon — Oral (early accept): "Fine-grained rib fracture diagnosis with hyperbolic embeddings." — arXiv · MICCAI 2025
  • AOCR 2025 / IRIA Annual Congress, Chennai — faculty talks & workshops. — AOCR 2025 · IRIA

2023

  • RSNA 2023, Chicago — Trainee Research Prize (MSK): "AIRib: end-to-end pipeline for sensitive rib fracture detection." — RSNA
  • RSNA 2023, Chicago — Cutting-Edge Oral (Imaging Informatics): "Optimising LLM-augmented speech recognition for radiology reporting."
  • RSNA 2023, Chicago — Cutting-Edge Oral (Imaging Informatics): "Comparative analysis of speech-recognition pipelines for radiology reporting."
  • RSNA 2023, Chicago — Digital Poster (Education/IR): "Realizing the promise of AI in interventional radiology: a primer for residents."
  • International Skeletal Society (MSK 2023), London — Digital Poster: "AI in musculoskeletal interventions: where are we now and what's next?" — ISS
  • ISVIR 2023, Hyderabad — Oral (Interventional Oncology): "AI in Interventional Oncology: challenges & opportunities." — ISVIR 2023

Earlier

  • JAANA CME 2019, Los Angeles — Keynote: "Healthcare research & innovation: emerging directions for clinicians & scientists." — JAANA
  • RePORT India Joint Leadership Meeting 2018, New Delhi — Scientific talk: MGIT-960 false positives. — RePORT India
  • IBS (EARC) 2018, JIPMER — Poster: arterial stiffness & carotid IMT. — JIPMER
  • EBCCON 2018, Chennai — Poster: vascular function in hypothyroidism.
